title: tempdisagg: A Python Framework for Temporal Disaggregation of Time Series Data
abstract: arXiv:2503.22054v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: tempdisagg is an open-source Python package that estimates a high-frequency time series from low-frequency benchmarks and, optionally, high-frequency indicators, such that the estimates aggregate exactly to the benchmarks. It implements the regression-based estimators of Chow-Lin, Fern\'andez and Litterman, the dynamic Chow-Lin model, the Denton and Denton-Cholette benchmarking procedures and uniform distribution, with the formulas and defaults of the R package tempdisagg, together with the autoregressive distributed-lag model of Proietti as an experimental extension. All generalised least squares estimators share one engine in which the residual covariance is applied through its triangular factor, so that one likelihood evaluation costs $O(n\,n_l^2)$ instead of $O(n^2 n_l)$. translated_title: tempdisagg：一个用于时间序列数据时间分解的Python框架
translated_abstract: tempdisagg是一个开源Python包，用于从低频基准数据以及可选的高频指标中估计高频时间序列，并确保估计值能够精确聚合到基准数据上。该包实现了基于回归的Chow-Lin、Fernández和Litterman估计器、动态Chow-Lin模型、Denton和Denton-Cholette基准调整程序以及均匀分布方法，其公式和默认设置与R语言包tempdisagg保持一致，同时将Proietti的自回归分布滞后模型作为实验性扩展纳入其中。所有广义最小二乘（GLS）估计器共享同一个计算引擎，其中残差协方差通过其三角分解因子来应用，使得一次似然函数评估的计算成本从O(n²n_l)降低到O(n·n_l²)。该包提供完整的统计推断功能，包括系数估计、标准误、基于似然的评价准则、预测方差以及自回归的完整轮廓分析。
tldr: tempdisagg是一个开源Python框架，实现了Chow-Lin、Denton等经典时间分解与基准调整方法，并通过基于三角分解的统一GLS计算引擎将似然评估的计算复杂度从O(n²n_l)降至O(n·n_l²)。
en_tdlr: tempdisagg is an open-source Python framework implementing classical temporal disaggregation and benchmarking methods (Chow-Lin, Fernández, Litterman, Denton, etc.) with a unified GLS engine that reduces likelihood evaluation cost from O(n²n_l) to O(n·n_l²).
